notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); Taxes and Intergovernmental split by fund column using the fund budget schedules (pp12-17), pieces tie exactly. Debt principal/interest/admin cost are printed under Other Financing Sources (Uses) on p6 and recorded in other_financing. Fund balances (not cash) rolled forward; cash fields null. Business-type lines from the modified cash proprietary statement (p8), which ties to the Statement of Activities business-type column (p2: expenditures 155,190, charges 281,333, interest 71); the accrual proprietary statement (p9) is not used; proprietary from the Statement of Cash Flows total column (p10, no investing section). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p4, totals equal the p1 governmental column), business-type lines and totals from p1. Detail: individual fund budget schedules (General, Street, Debt Service, Sales Tax, Swimming Pool, Water, Sewer) and the nonmajor combining statement (p21) for Park, Library, Fitness Center and Parks and Recreation Board funds (Swimming Pool taken from its own schedule p18); the all-funds budgetary statement (p11) is not recorded to avoid double counting; Cemetery, Library Board and Community Ambulance have no schedule in the trim. Lines with blank Actual (Street Reimbursements, Sales Tax Motor vehicle tax and Bond proceeds, Water Capital outlay, Sewer Payroll taxes) are omitted. Read pages 1-21 of 21
